observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan in nine tiles at full size (2870 x 2615) with a 0.02 grid, against the model rendered from the photo's camera (out/recon/holistic/views/g092-a/)
covers: SP-2M2 whole, the curtain and the indicator box at its forward end, the roof's edge over the right wall, the corner aft of SP-2M2 (the blue lamp, the tube, SP-3M-2 open, the first-aid box) and the wheel arches and floor under it

details.what: the roof lining's edge where it drops into a box-section cornice along the right wall: a dark crease running aft and turning up over the corner
details.size_cue: the cornice's face is about a third of an SP-2M2 block high (0.08-0.10 m)
details.note: first read as a cornice along the wall; I1 (9 Nov 2026) found it runs square across: this is the top arris of the roof's box beam (data/cabins/osa_ak_shell.json), both arrises' rays constant in (y, z)

details.what: the cornice's light vertical face, running aft along the wall over SP-2M2's aft column and on past the corner
details.size_cue: 0.08-0.10 m deep (against the aft column's 0.6 m)
details.note: the box beam's forward face, not a cornice along the wall (I1); its depth of about 0.15 m from the two arrises' rays

details.what: the cornice's underside: a surface sloping down and outboard to the top of the wall, the hull's upper side plate leaning in over the racks; SP-2M2's top meets it with a dark shadow gap
details.size_cue: the slope's band is 0.1-0.15 m wide in plan, from the rack's top to the cornice
details.note: the lining's sloping ledge forward of the beam, from the rack's top rail in to the crease (I1)

details.what: a joint in the roof lining (a dark crack across the panel)
a strip along the top of the wall aft of SP-2M2, under the cornice, with a row of six hex bolt heads
SP-2M2's aft upright: a white aluminium channel post the rack's height, about 35 mm wide, its flange lit, with a flared foot
details.size_cue: about 35 mm wide (against a 30 mm connector)

details.what: the upright between the forward and middle columns: an aluminium channel standing about 25 mm proud of the plates, two flanges and a recess between
the upright between the middle and aft columns, as d07
the rails between the rows: dark steel strips in a shadow band under each row, the plates' lower lips over them

pattern.note: four rails in each of the three columns

details.what: every block plate's corners rounded (radius about 10 mm) and a lip all round the plate
details.size_cue: radius about a third of a connector's width

details.what: the raised chart tables on f2, f3, m3 and m4: white cases with rounded corners on four dark feet
the tables' printing: СХЕМА РАСПОЛОЖЕНИЯ УЗЛОВ БЛОКА И ПОДКЛЮЧЕНИЯ УСИЛИТЕЛЕЙ, a ruled grid of cells and БЛОК СИГН. И РЕЗЕРВ under it
each block's type plate at its top right (black letters on a small light plate, ОР-31М and the like)
the legends printed either side of the vertical terminal strips and under every knob, socket and lamp (small black text on the plates)

pattern.note: one legend column per strip, and the knobs' and lamps' legends

details.what: the blocks' U-handles: bent grey rods on round feet, in pairs on f2, f3, m3, m4
the round test connectors' caps hanging on short chains
red sealing wires through some connectors and screws (lead seals on red wire)
the plates' paint: an off-white (ivory) enamel, slightly glossy, dull grey-white uprights, the strips' brown bakelite, the lamps' yellow and orange
the curtain gathered at the right wall at SP-2M2's forward edge: khaki-yellow cotton in deep vertical folds, about eight over 0.15 m, falling to a bunched hem at the bench's height
an olive-green edge or second cloth at the curtain's lower end
the white box at the forward end's foot with ИНДИКАТОР ОБЕСТОЧЕННОСТИ printed on its face

the blue lamp on the right wall just aft of SP-2M2's top: a chrome ring bezel about 0.1 m across round a blue glass dome, its wires hanging below; the right wall's own lamp (seen caged in g096-a, d24), a second blue lamp beside the bulkhead's; the model has only the bulkhead's
details.size_cue: about 0.1 m across (against the 35 mm post)

details.what: a white cable from the blue lamp up the cornice's underside and aft to the round olive item, clipped at two points
a round olive-drab drum about 0.12 m across with a flat face to the aisle, on the cornice at the rear right (a fan or a sensor)
SP-3M-2's top block: a light plate with lamps and connectors and a vertical U-handle at its aft end
SP-3M-2's middle open (its front folded down): a dark grey chassis box with relays and wiring above it and a row of white components below; the model shows a closed face
a bent aluminium tube about 40 mm across from the corner under the blue lamp diagonally down and aft to the wheel arch
a hinged aluminium flap clamped to the tube, two hinge knuckles at its top
a grey T-handle key on a clip, aft of SP-2M2's lower aft block
a small white-wrapped clip above the T-key
the first-aid box: white, rounded, a red cross on its face, in a black strap holder on the aft wheel arch's slope
white cables down the corner between SP-2M2's post and the tube, one with a blue tag
the forward wheel-arch housing in the floor at the right wall: a box with a sloped top rising aft, its forward face about 0.3 m high, dark grey with worn light edges
the aft housing beside it: a deeper box with a recess open to the aisle, the first-aid box on its slope
the floor's plates with seams across the aisle, a worn light grey surface, a step down at the wheel arches' foot
the rack's foot: a dark kick plate under the bottom row, sloping back to the floor
strap fittings and a buckle under the aft column's bottom block
the roof and cornice lining: a matt light grey-green, uneven, darker where it slopes
the aft column's fuse panels: rows of yellow-capped fuse holders with chrome guard rails across them
the OR-31M's three dial bezels and the OR-11M's two meters with their hoods, the socket field between
